title: The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes
author: Suzanne Collins
summary: Set decades before the original trilogy, this is the story of an eighteen-year-old Coriolanus Snow in a capital still scarred by war. He is assigned to mentor a tribute from District 12 in the tenth Hunger Games, and his ambitions are on the line.
readIf: you want a villain-origin story about how charm and ambition curdle.
skipIf: you want a rebellion tale like the original trilogy, since the main character is no hero.

pairings.reason: The original story it leads into; reading it first makes this prequel's quiet echoes land harder.
Another account of how young people turn on each other when a violent system gives them permission.
A harsher, faster dystopia of caste, competition and a protagonist forced into a deadly game.
